name: Scott Laneri
title: Principal & Project Management
bio:
Scott joined The Ritchie Group in 2014. During his time at TRG, Scott has largely focused on developing multi-family and hospitality projects. He is involved with every step of the development process and specializes in financial analysis, deal sourcing, capital structuring, and development management.

Scott received a Master of Real Estate Development from the Eccles School of Business at the University of Utah. He graduated from the Jon M. Huntsman School of Business at Utah State University with honors and received Bachelor of Science Degrees in Finance and Economics. In his free time, Scott enjoys skiing, playing soccer, reading, and spending time with his family.
